Guides for setting up monitors, alerts, on-call and status pages. Search articles /// Getting started Set up monitors and bring your team in. Create your first monitor Add a URL, choose how often to check it and where alerts should go. Most teams are done in two minutes. Invite your team Add teammates, choose their roles and let them sign in with your identity provider. /// Alerts and on-call Route alerts to the right person, every time. Set up an escalation policy Decide who gets paged first, how long Navy waits for an acknowledgement and who gets paged next. Why didn't I get an alert? The most common reasons an alert does not arrive, and how to check each one. /// Status pages Keep customers informed during incidents. Publish a status page Create a public page that shows the health of your services and keeps customers updated during incidents. Use a custom domain Serve your status page from a domain you own, such as status.yourcompany
